events.subtitle: OurHome Tour — Tokyo
events.category: Instrumental guitar duo / Mexico-Japan cultural exchange / New album tour
events.factual_description: Udo Music Office presents Rodrigo y Gabriela's OurHome Tour at Zepp DiverCity (TOKYO) on Monday, January 25, 2027, with doors at 6:00 PM and the performance at 7:00 PM. The official promoter page lists reserved 1F-front/2F seats at ¥14,000 and rear-1F standing tickets at ¥13,000, with a separate drink charge. The same official itinerary continues to Nagoya on January 26 and Osaka on January 27. Udo and Rodrigo y Gabriela's own album materials state that OurHome was self-produced and recorded at NK Sound Tokyo and includes Japan-linked collaborators such as Hiromi and Marty Friedman; Udo also documents the project's Naoki Urasawa connection. Those album collaborators are not announced as live guests for Zepp DiverCity, so the event lineup records only Rodrigo Sánchez and Gabriela Quintero.

Rodrigo y Gabriela's primary album page verifies the NK Sound Tokyo recording context and Japan-linked guest musicians; Apple Music provides the exact OurHome album destination. The Zepp venue page verifies the venue's Koto City address. No unannounced live guests, resale pricing, or alternate ticket destination is inferred.

en.why_it_matters: The Tokyo date closes a loop that the Washington stop cannot. OurHome was made at NK Sound Tokyo and draws Japanese musicians and visual culture into Rodrigo y Gabriela's two-guitar language; bringing that material back to Tokyo makes the cultural exchange part of the live context rather than background biography. The duo's percussive acoustic attack already sits naturally between Latin groove, metal-derived precision and instrumental conversation, and this is the city where the new record's Japan thread becomes most legible onstage.
en.trip_verdict: If January overlaps with Tokyo, actively make room for the Zepp DiverCity night and build the evening around it. The three-city Japan run means there is no need to rebuild a larger itinerary around January 25 specifically, but the Tokyo date is the most direct place to hear this Japan-made album return to its recording context.

es.why_it_matters: La fecha de Tokio cierra un círculo que la parada de Washington no puede cerrar. OurHome se hizo en NK Sound Tokyo y mete músicos y cultura visual japonesa dentro del lenguaje de dos guitarras de Rodrigo y Gabriela; llevar ese material de regreso a Tokio convierte el intercambio cultural en parte del contexto en vivo, no en un dato biográfico. El ataque acústico y percusivo del dúo ya vive naturalmente entre groove latino, precisión nacida del metal y conversación instrumental, y ésta es la ciudad donde el hilo japonés del disco nuevo se vuelve más claro sobre el escenario.
es.trip_verdict: Si enero coincide con Tokio, sí le haría espacio activamente a la noche de Zepp DiverCity y armaría la velada alrededor del concierto. La gira japonesa de tres ciudades evita que haya que rehacer un itinerario mayor alrededor del 25 de enero en particular, pero Tokio es el lugar más directo para escuchar cómo este disco hecho en Japón regresa al contexto donde se grabó.
